goal: Tell a UOR Foundation repository whether its topic tags and release versioning follow STANDARDS.md.

app.name: uor-repo-standards
app.title: Repository tags and versioning
app.purpose: Decide whether a UOR Foundation repository carries the identity tags, exactly one tier tag and exactly one status tag STANDARDS.md requires, and versions its releases with Semantic Versioning when it is Tier 1 or 2.

fields.name: tier
fields.means: the repository's tier: core framework, implementation, presentation or experiment

fields.name: identity
fields.means: both identity topic tags, uor and uor-foundation

fields.name: tiertags
fields.means: how many tier topic tags the repository carries

fields.name: statustags
fields.means: how many status topic tags the repository carries

fields.name: versioning
fields.means: how its release tags are versioned

meanings.untagged: its topic tags do not follow STANDARDS.md
meanings.unversioned: a Tier 1 or Tier 2 repository releases without Semantic Versioning
meanings.conformant: every requirement and recommendation of its tier is met

rules.why: STANDARDS.md: every repository carries uor and uor-foundation
STANDARDS.md: exactly one tier tag per repository
STANDARDS.md: exactly one status tag per repository
STANDARDS.md and GOVERNANCE.md 8: Tier 1 and 2 repositories follow Semantic Versioning 2.0.0

app.otherwiseWhy: STANDARDS.md: the tags and versioning of the tier are followed

properties.why: every repository carries exactly one tier tag
every repository carries exactly one status tag
Semantic Versioning is required only at Tiers 1 and 2

stakeholders.name: Repository Maintainer
stakeholders.text: Keeps a repository healthy and needs to know whether it meets its tier and the first gap to close.

stakeholders.name: Organization Owner
stakeholders.text: Holds final governance authority and needs every repository measured against the same published norms.

components.name: GitHub repository settings
components.text: The files, branch protection and topic tags the request is read from.

components.name: Template gate
components.text: A template instance's just vv, which asks this app about its own repository.

threats.name: Untagged repository hidden
threats.text: A repository without its tier and status tags is shown as conformant, so it drops out of tier-based oversight.

control.name: Exactly one of each
control.text: Tier and status tags must each number exactly one.

quality.requirement: Every tag and versioning rule modeled
quality.text: Each STANDARDS.md topic tag rule and the Semantic Versioning rule is one rule.
quality.measureText: STANDARDS.md tag or versioning rules with no rule.
